result.title: Allocentric Memory, Egocentric Acting: A Dual-Frame VLA for Urban Aerial Navigation
result.summary: Language-goal aerial navigation requires a UAV to reach a destination specified in natural language using observations collected during flight. A key challenge is linking changing egocentric perception with spatial evidence anchored to stable locations for long-range navigation. We propose CityNav-VLA, a dual-frame vision-language-action model for urban navigation integrating dynamic egocentric context with persistent allocentric spatial memory. The UAV incrementally accumulates visual observations on a fixed north-up map initialized with geographic and landmark priors, preserving evidence across viewpoint changes. A dynamic query conditioned on the instruction, current observations, UAV state, and motion history retrieves relevant memory evidence to predict a map-frame target. A deterministic controller converts this target into body-frame commands using the UAV's current pose, connecting global reasoning with egocentric execution. To reduce target fluctuations over long horizons, early goal commitment (EGC) fixes the execution target to the coordinate-wise median of the first $K$ predictions without extra trainable parameters. On Test Unseen, CityNav-VLA reduces NE by 21.2% and improves SR and SPL by 15.8% and 30.9%, respectively. It also reduces NE by 6.2% and improves SR and SPL by 5.6% and 23.2%, respectively, relative to the former SOTA after dataset refinement. Cumulative ablations show that navigation-map features yield the largest gains, while metric coordinates further improve endpoint accuracy. With a 4B-scale backbone, inference averages 0.68 s per decision with 8.6 GB peak memory on a single A100, presenting remarkable model efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CityNav-VLA，一种双框架 VLA 模型：将动态自我中心观测与固定的北向 allocentric 空间记忆地图结合，由指令与飞行状态条件化的查询检索记忆证据以预测地图坐标目标，再由确定性控制器转为机体动作，并用前 K 次预测的中位数做早期目标锁定。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把跨视角视觉证据累积到持久地图记忆、再按需检索」的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与外部证据进入推理状态的问题相关，但论文目标为无人机导航控制，未研究内部 latent 推理状态，可供核查。
